description: Seeds two resting BTCUSDT limit orders on the scenario it is named with: the open-order list holds them, cancels are accepted by the scenario's order cancel, and the three mode-switch calls answer with an active-order refusal whose code is unconfirmed.

merge_patch.retMsg: Mode switch refused: the account has active orders

POST /v5/position/switch-mode.note: No recording exists. 24-internal-schemas section 8.6 has no active-order refusal of a mode switch, and its one position-mode entry, 110025, is a hard error (alert and block the account) that TC-421 does not expect. So this code is outside the table, and section 8.6's last row applies: a plain reject. 110028 is the exchange's open-order refusal of a position-mode switch from recollection only. The message describes the condition; it is not the exchange's wording (README, unconfirmed codes).
